chunks: Al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik asked him:
Is the funeral prayer performed for the deceased in the mosque? He said: “Yes.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform the funeral prayer for the deceased in the mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that salat over the deceased may be performed in the mosque. It indicates the permissibility of conducting funeral prayer within the masjid setting.
